name: Tourism Arrivals Forecasting
blurb: Machine-learning research predicting weekly international tourist arrivals to Sri Lanka from public search-intent signals — testing whether search behaviour leads booking behaviour.
detail: Aligned noisy weekly search-volume series against official arrival statistics, ran cross-correlation analysis at varying lags to identify the predictive window, engineered lagged and rolling features, and evaluated regression models against seasonal baselines — giving tourism operators a forecast signal weeks ahead of conventional reporting.
